description: Lists footage files and folders in the user's Huasheng library. Changes nothing. Pass folder_id to open one folder; omit it for the top level. Pass list="uploads" for a different set: files the user sent while editing a video, which Huasheng never read and therefore cannot pick on its own. huasheng_manage_materials action=add with one of their ids reads it into the library.

folder_id.description: Folder to list; omit for top level

list.description: "library" (default) is footage Huasheng has read and can pick. "uploads" is what the user sent while editing — unread, and not in folders

sort.description: Order by when added (default) or last changed, newest first

status.description: Only files in this state; omit for all

name: huasheng_list_materials
title: View the footage library
